question: Why did the average total amount per yellow taxi trip jump on Monday 20 Jan 2025 compared with the other Mondays in January 2025?

calls.content:
{
  "sql": "SELECT y.trip_date,
       y.avg_total_amount,
       y.trips,
       y.avg_trip_distance
FROM whybot.yellow_daily y
WHERE y.trip_date IN (DATE '2025-01-20', DATE '2025-01-06', DATE '2025-01-13', DATE '2025-01-27')
ORDER BY y.trip_date",
  "tables_used": ["whybot.yellow_daily"],
  "note": "Baseline comparison across four Mondays in January 2025"
}

{"sql":"SELECT y.trip_date, y.avg_total_amount, h.holiday_name, CASE WHEN h.holiday_name IS NOT NULL THEN 'holiday' ELSE 'regular' END AS day_type FROM whybot.yellow_daily y LEFT JOIN whybot.us_holidays h ON h.holiday_date = y.trip_date WHERE y.trip_date IN (DATE '2025-01-13', DATE '2025-01-20', DATE '2025-01-27') ORDER BY y.trip_date","tables_used":["whybot.yellow_daily","whybot.us_holidays"],"note":"LEFT JOIN us_holidays ensures one row per date; holiday_name will be NULL for non-holidays. CASE tags day_type. No date_dim needed."}

{
  "sql": "SELECT y.trip_date,
       y.trips,
       w.prcp_mm,
       w.snow_mm,
       w.tmax_c,
       w.tmin_c
FROM whybot.yellow_daily y
JOIN whybot.nyc_weather_daily w ON w.obs_date = y.trip_date
WHERE y.trip_date IN (DATE '2025-01-20', DATE '2025-01-06', DATE '2025-01-13', DATE '2025-01-27')
ORDER BY y.trip_date",
  "tables_used": ["whybot.yellow_daily", "whybot.nyc_weather_daily"],
  "note": "Baseline Mondays selected as the other Mondays in January 2025 excluding 2025-01-20"
}

{
  "sql": "SELECT y.trip_date,
       y.trips,
       y.avg_total_amount,
       y.avg_trip_distance,
       MAX(CASE WHEN trip_date = DATE '2025-01-20' THEN y.avg_total_amount END) AS target_amount,
       AVG(CASE WHEN trip_date <> DATE '2025-01-20' AND dayofweek(trip_date) = 1 THEN y.avg_total_amount END) AS baseline_avg_amount
FROM whybot.yellow_daily y
WHERE y.trip_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-01-31'
GROUP BY y.trip_date
ORDER BY y.trip_date",
  "tables_used": ["whybot.yellow_daily"],
  "note": "Uses conditional aggregation to compare target date 2025-01-20 against other Mondays in January 2025, avoiding self-joins on the same view per Zetaris quirk #1."
}

{"sql":"SELECT y.trip_date,
       MAX(CASE WHEN trip_date = DATE '2025-01-20' THEN y.avg_trip_distance END) AS target_distance,
       AVG(CASE WHEN trip_date <> DATE '2025-01-20' AND dayofweek(trip_date) = 2 THEN y.avg_trip_distance END) AS baseline_avg_distance
FROM whybot.yellow_daily y
WHERE y.trip_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-01-31'
GROUP BY y.trip_date
ORDER BY y.trip_date","tables_used":["whybot.yellow_daily"],"note":"Uses conditional aggregation to compare 2025-01-20 Monday distance against other Mondays in January. dayofweek=2 targets Mondays (1=Sunday per Spark docs)."}

{"sql":"SELECT y.trip_date, y.avg_total_amount AS avg_total_amount, y.avg_trip_distance AS avg_trip_distance, CASE WHEN dayofweek(y.trip_date) = 2 THEN 'Monday' ELSE NULL END AS day_type, MAX(CASE WHEN dayofweek(y.trip_date) = 2 AND y.trip_date < DATE '2025-01-20' THEN y.avg_total_amount END) AS baseline_avg_amount, MAX(CASE WHEN dayofweek(y.trip_date) = 2 AND y.trip_date < DATE '2025-01-20' THEN y.avg_trip_distance END) AS baseline_avg_distance FROM whybot.yellow_daily y WHERE y.trip_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-01-31' GROUP BY y.trip_date ORDER BY y.trip_date","tables_used":["whybot.yellow_daily"],"note":"Uses conditional MAX aggregation to avoid MISSING_AGGREGATION error; baseline computed over earlier Mondays in January 2025."}

{
  "sql": "SELECT y.trip_date, y.avg_total_amount, y.avg_trip_distance,
       CASE WHEN dayofweek(y.trip_date) = 2 THEN 'Monday' ELSE NULL END AS day_type,
       MAX(CASE WHEN dayofweek(y.trip_date) = 2 AND y.trip_date < DATE '2025-01-20' THEN y.avg_total_amount END) AS baseline_avg_amount,
       MAX(CASE WHEN dayofweek(y.trip_date) = 2 AND y.trip_date < DATE '2025-01-20' THEN y.avg_trip_distance END) AS baseline_avg_distance
FROM whybot.yellow_daily y
WHERE y.trip_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-01-31'
GROUP BY y.trip_date, y.avg_total_amount, y.avg_trip_distance
ORDER BY y.trip_date
LIMIT 500",
  "tables_used": ["whybot.yellow_daily"],
  "note": "Group by all selected non-aggregated columns to satisfy Zetaris MISSING_AGGREGATION quirk; MAX conditional aggregation computes baseline across prior Mondays only."
}

{
  "sql": "SELECT y.trip_date,
       y.trips AS trip_count,
       y.avg_total_amount AS avg_fare,
       CASE WHEN dayofweek(y.trip_date) = 2 THEN 'Monday' ELSE NULL END AS weekday_flag,
       MAX(CASE WHEN dayofweek(y.trip_date) = 2 AND y.trip_date < DATE '2025-01-20' THEN y.avg_total_amount END) AS prev_monday_avg,
       MAX(CASE WHEN dayofweek(y.trip_date) = 2 AND y.trip_date > DATE '2025-01-20' THEN y.avg_total_amount END) AS next_monday_avg
FROM whybot.yellow_daily y
WHERE y.trip_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-01-31'
GROUP BY y.trip_date, y.trips, y.avg_total_amount
ORDER BY y.trip_date",
  "tables_used": ["whybot.yellow_daily"],
  "note": "Compares 2025-01-20 avg_total_amount against preceding and following Mondays in January to assess volatility and outlier status."
}

{"sql":"SELECT y.trip_date, y.trips, y.avg_total_amount, y.avg_trip_distance, d.d_day_name, CASE WHEN h.holiday_date IS NOT NULL THEN 'YES' ELSE 'NO' END AS is_holiday FROM whybot.yellow_daily y JOIN whybot.date_dim d ON d.d_date = y.trip_date LEFT JOIN whybot.us_holidays h ON h.holiday_date = y.trip_date WHERE y.trip_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-01-31' AND d.d_day_name = 'Monday' ORDER BY y.trip_date","tables_used":["whybot.yellow_daily","whybot.date_dim","whybot.us_holidays"],"note":"Shows Monday Jan 2025 trips with holiday flag; avg_total_amount is available in yellow_daily but fare components are not."}

{"sql":"SELECT y.trip_date, y.trips, y.avg_total_amount, y.avg_trip_distance, CASE WHEN h.holiday_date IS NOT NULL THEN 'YES' ELSE 'NO' END AS is_holiday FROM whybot.yellow_daily y LEFT JOIN whybot.us_holidays h ON h.holiday_date = y.trip_date WHERE y.trip_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-01-31' AND (y.trip_date - DATE '2025-01-01') % 7 = 0 ORDER BY y.trip_date","tables_used":["whybot.yellow_daily","whybot.us_holidays"],"note":"Uses modulo arithmetic to isolate Mondays in January 2025 instead of referencing whybot.date_dim. LEFT JOIN ensures result is never empty. Every computed column is aliased with snake_case."}

{"sql":"SELECT y.trip_date, y.trips, y.avg_total_amount, y.avg_trip_distance, d.d_day_name, CASE WHEN h.holiday_date IS NOT NULL THEN 'YES' ELSE 'NO' END AS is_holiday FROM whybot.yellow_daily y JOIN whybot.tpcds_db.date_dim d ON d.d_date = y.trip_date LEFT JOIN whybot.us_holidays h ON h.holiday_date = y.trip_date WHERE y.trip_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-01-31' AND d.d_day_name = 'Monday' ORDER BY y.trip_date","tables_used":["whybot.yellow_daily","whybot.tpcds_db.date_dim","whybot.us_holidays"],"note":"Uses tpcds_db.date_dim as the weekday source per allowlist; conditional aggregation pattern avoids self-joins on whybot.views. Filters to Mondays in Jan 2025."}

{
  "sql": "SELECT y.trip_date,
       y.avg_total_amount AS avg_fare,
       CASE WHEN dayofweek(y.trip_date) = 1 THEN 'Sunday'
            WHEN dayofweek(y.trip_date) = 2 THEN 'Monday'
            WHEN dayofweek(y.trip_date) = 3 THEN 'Tuesday'
            WHEN dayofweek(y.trip_date) = 4 THEN 'Wednesday'
            WHEN dayofweek(y.trip_date) = 5 THEN 'Thursday'
            WHEN dayofweek(y.trip_date) = 6 THEN 'Friday'
            WHEN dayofweek(y.trip_date) = 7 THEN 'Saturday'
       END AS d_day_name
FROM whybot.yellow_daily y
WHERE y.trip_date IN (DATE '2025-01-20', DATE '2025-01-06', DATE '2025-01-13', DATE '2025-01-27')
ORDER BY y.trip_date",
  "tables_used": ["whybot.yellow_daily"],
  "note": "Selects avg_total_amount for the target Monday and three baseline Mondays in January 2025, with weekday name for context. No self-joins, no semicolons."
}
